spdxLicense: OFL-1.1; preserve exact original Cabin and current source notices
scope: Append one separate own-class MarkBase lookup for four native e/o dotbelow bases and four actual acute/grave mark forms. Retain all native drawings, metrics, hints, old lookup definitions and the separate accepted Lithuanian/kerning rules. No new glyph or scalar.

rule.baseAnchor: otRound of actual full-ink x centre, yMax+90
rule.markAnchor: otRound of actual native mark-ink x centre, yMin
rule.lookup: Separate bounded MarkBase appended to the native mark feature; no generic global mark coverage and no accidental extra grave coverage on the Lithuanian base set.

caseBank: Join the eight stated YO IDs to the lead-owned canonical bank once its append is complete. The actual source strings and executed yo/script/direction are already explicit below; no second reader/virtual scenario bank is created.

limits: Dotbelow and tone attachment in the selected eight Unicode strings only. The CLDR49/GF orthography-method question does not authorise U0329 or a universal language-support claim.
engineeringChecks: Actual eight NFC/NFD text pairs in all four cuts and TTF/WOFF2, same source base/mark contours and advances, exact integer mark origins/gaps.

Retained old definitions, source glyph/GID remapping, common family ink envelope and independent reproduction.
